_comment: G13 pinned-host external manifest artifact (spec section 5 preamble: the compat host pins DSH package, Node, profile digest, adapter and canonicalizer versions). The pinned DSH Node host identity is UNCONFIRMED (no package.json / node_modules / vendored SDK in this repository; the local Node v24.13.1 runtime is available but the upstream DSH package identity/version/source is missing -- a user decision, see the plan's open questions). Every external item is therefore null + note: an UNRESOLVED item. While any item is unresolved the compat contract MUST NOT be declared passed (reporter-enforced) and the whole real-I/O test boundary stays blocked.

dsh_package.note: upstream Cordis/DSH package identity (name@version + source) unconfirmed -- user decision pending

node_version.note: pinned Node version for the host unconfirmed (local v24.13.1 exists but is not a pin)

profile_digest.note: compat profile digest unconfirmed -- depends on the pinned package

canonicalizer_version.note: compat-side canonicalizer version unconfirmed -- must match the native canonical_profile_version@v1 pipeline

dispatch_interception.note: the three-row pre-verification of the pinned package's public integration points has not run -- blocked on the pinned package identity

driver_switch_capability.note: conservative created-immutable declaration for the seeded manifest row -- without the pinned host a 'supported' claim cannot be made (deviation ledger G13 block)

blocked_unlock_chain: user/upstream confirms the pinned DSH package -> section 5.2 pre-verification produces its three-row verdict -> manifest items turn from null+note to verified values -> real-I/O-layer subcases unblock
